answer: Ocean keeps an attestation floor equal to the number of jetty already live there. A jetty is admitted only with a hardware root whose attested age in epochs is at least that floor, and registration burns sonnet equal to the root's age; the floor is read and incremented atomically at commit. Each successive clone needs an older root, so a thousand clones burn roughly five hundred thousand sonnet and the same root-epochs. Parallel aging cannot lower total root-epochs, and roots are not fungible. It breaks if roots are virtualized, attestations forged, or ocean resets the floor.
